notesForNextSession: bf-init reverse-engineered this repo against project-plan/PLAN.md (the 15-day master plan), then it was re-scoped for the two-repo Blueframe workspace "lords-dashboard" (backend: this repo; frontend: `lords-regiment-dashboard` at ../lords-regiment-dashboard). SHIPPED so far: project skeleton, config+Joi, common infra (crypto/filters/interceptors/DTOs), the full 28-table data model (entities + initial migration + 7 seeders), Discord OAuth2+JWT auth (unit+e2e), and health. EVERYTHING ELSE IS UNBUILT: every feature module is entities-only and commented out in app.module.ts. Recommended start = Phase 01 foundations (T-0006 CapabilitiesGuard, T-0007 AuditService) since almost every feature task dependsOn them, then Members (T-0010). Bot (T-0020/21/22) needs discord.js + a NEW migration that does not exist yet. NOTE: the frontend integration + missing admin UI were previously (wrongly) tracked HERE as T-0023/T-0024 with area:"frontend" and ../lords-regiment-dashboard/ paths -- that made the backend render a bogus "frontend" planet. They now live in the FRONTEND repo where the work physically sits (lords-regiment-dashboard T-0011/T-0012/T-0017); this repo references them via cross-repo deps (see T-0025). Answer the three questionnaire tasks (T-0026/27/28) before seeding the rank ladder / building the bot.

tasks.title: Project skeleton & bootstrap
tasks.summary: NestJS 11 app bootstrap: main.ts (helmet, cookie-parser, global validation pipe, Swagger at /api/docs, /api prefix), root AppModule, global JwtAuthGuard + ThrottlerGuard, typed configuration + Joi env validation.

testPlan.desc: app boots and serves /api/docs + /api/health

tasks.title: Common infrastructure & crypto
tasks.summary: Shared plumbing: all-exceptions filter, logging interceptor, enum barrel, pagination DTOs, and the AES-256-GCM encryption transformer used for Discord tokens and event/server passwords. Encryption transformer has unit tests.

testPlan.desc: encryption.transformer.spec round-trips encrypt/decrypt

regressionRisk.desc: encryption transformer is shared by identities/events/applications; a key or algorithm change breaks decryption of stored ciphertext

tasks.title: Data model: 28 entities + initial migration + seeders
tasks.summary: The full normalized 3NF schema as TypeORM entities across all 11 feature areas, the InitialSchema migration creating every table, the TypeORM data-source (snake_case naming strategy, synchronize off), db:create script, and 7 idempotent seeders (accent tones, audit actions, medals, ranks, regiment, role-permissions matrix, dev owner).

testPlan.desc: db:setup (create -> migrate -> seed) runs idempotently against MySQL 8

regressionRisk.desc: the seeded rank ladder may not match the canonical ladder (see T-0026 Q1); reseeding after correction is destructive

history.note: created during bf-init; schema shipped, feature modules on top not yet built

tasks.title: Discord OAuth2 sign-in + JWT auth
tasks.summary: Full auth module: /auth/discord redirect with CSRF state cookie, /auth/discord/callback exchanging the code and upserting an encrypted discord_identities row (linking a member if one exists), /auth/me CurrentUser projection, /auth/logout. JWT strategy, JwtAuthGuard, coarse RolesGuard + @Roles/@Public/@CurrentUser decorators. Covered by unit tests and a full e2e OAuth flow with Discord mocked.

testPlan.desc: auth.e2e drives full sign-in: new identity persists encrypted, returning sign-in resolves linked member

tasks.title: Health module (liveness + DB probe)
tasks.summary: Health controller/module exposing a liveness endpoint and a database connectivity probe. No test coverage yet; marked review pending a smoke check.

testPlan.desc: GET /api/health returns ok and reports DB reachable

history.note: created during bf-init; exists but no test

tasks.title: Capability authorization layer
tasks.summary: CapabilitiesGuard + @RequireCapability() decorator reading the seeded role_permissions matrix (capability-based, stricter than the coarse RolesGuard). The matrix data + entity exist; the guard/decorator that enforce it do not.

testPlan.desc: guard allows/denies by role_permissions row, not by role membership

tasks.title: Shared AuditService + audit interceptor
tasks.summary: An AuditService and interceptor/helper so every mutating endpoint writes an audit_log_entries row (actor, action from audit_actions, before/after, severity, discord_sync_status). audit_actions are seeded; the service is not built.

testPlan.desc: a mutation produces exactly one audit row with before/after captured

tasks.title: CI pipeline (GitHub Actions)
tasks.summary: .github/workflows/ci.yml running lint -> unit -> e2e (against a MySQL 8 service container) -> build on every push, gating the definition-of-done for each phase. Does not exist yet.

testPlan.desc: CI green on a clean push: lint + unit + e2e + build

tasks.title: Docker (app + MySQL)
tasks.summary: Dockerfile for the API plus docker-compose.yml running the app and MySQL 8 for local + prod parity (docker compose up should serve /api/health and /api/docs). Does not exist yet.

testPlan.desc: docker compose up serves /api/health

tasks.title: MembersModule — roster + admin actions + GDPR
tasks.summary: GET /members (filter + pagination), GET/PATCH /members/:id, admin actions (change rank/role, award/remove medal, suspend, ban, unban), service-record and command-info reads, and GDPR (deletion-request + confirm + export). Derived values (chevrons, events_attended, attendance_percent) computed server-side. Entities exist; module unbuilt.

testPlan.desc: each admin action is capability-gated and writes an audit row

tasks.title: RanksModule — CRUD + reorder + link-discord
tasks.summary: Ranks CRUD, precedence reorder, and Discord-role link fields (the sync itself lands with the bot). Entity + seed exist; module unbuilt.

questions.q: What is the canonical rank ladder to enforce/seed (admin ladder vs member/roster data disagree)?

testPlan.desc: reorder updates precedence transactionally; CRUD is capability-gated + audited

tasks.title: MedalsModule — CRUD + link-discord
tasks.summary: Medals catalog CRUD and Discord-role link fields; holders_count derived server-side. Entity + seed exist; module unbuilt.

questions.q: Can a medal be awarded more than once to the same member? Current UNIQUE(member_id, medal_id) forbids it.

testPlan.desc: CRUD capability-gated + audited; holders_count computed

tasks.title: Regiment profile & stats endpoints
tasks.summary: GET /regiment (public profile) and GET /regiment/stats (landing counters, public if public_stats), plus onboarding state endpoints. Values computed server-side, never trusted from client.

testPlan.desc: stats respect public_stats visibility toggle

tasks.title: ApplicationsModule — intake + decisions + promote
tasks.summary: Public POST /applications intake, admin list/detail, approve/decline/hold with moderator_note + discord_dm_message. Approve promotes to a members row (link identity, default rank, role=Member, set promoted_member_id, service-record + audit). Honors open_recruitment and reapplication detection. Entity exists; module unbuilt.

testPlan.desc: e2e: apply -> approve -> new member appears on roster with service-record + audit

tasks.title: EventsModule — CRUD + RSVP + attendees + password reveal
tasks.summary: Events CRUD (+ draft/archive), child writes for platforms/tags/notify_offsets, RSVP, attendee check-in, and the sensitive POST /:id/reveal-password (gated on RSVP + reveal_event_passwords capability, decrypts server_password, writes an audit row). Public vs member serialization; a scheduled job advances status upcoming->ongoing->previous. Entities exist; module unbuilt.

testPlan.desc: e2e: RSVP counts, reveal gating + audit row, public redaction of password/attendees

tasks.title: GalleryModule — submit + moderation + likes
tasks.summary: POST /gallery submit (forces pending), public GET (approved only) + filters, approve/decline moderation (auto_approve_trusted honored), like toggle, tagged members, soft-delete. Stores file URLs/refs only in v1; enforces regiment_settings size/type limits. Entities exist; module unbuilt.

testPlan.desc: e2e: submit -> moderate -> public visibility; like idempotency

tasks.title: AuditModule — read-only ledger
tasks.summary: GET /audit (filter severity/actor/action/date + search + pagination), GET /audit/:id (before/after drawer), GET /audit/export (CSV). Append-only, no write API (writes come from T-0007). Entities exist; read module unbuilt.

testPlan.desc: filters + CSV export are capability-gated (view_audit_log)

tasks.title: NotificationsModule — field dispatches
tasks.summary: GET /notifications, POST /notifications (compose — admin), POST /:id/read, GET /notifications/unread-count (notification_reads). Entities exist; module unbuilt.

testPlan.desc: unread-count reflects per-member read state

tasks.title: SettingsModule — config + permissions matrix + hazardous ops
tasks.summary: GET/PATCH /settings (profile, visibility toggles, gallery/event defaults, Holdfast server, backups/retention), GET/PATCH /settings/permissions (edit the role_permissions matrix that CapabilitiesGuard reads), and hazardous ops: transfer-ownership, transfer-discord, dissolve. regiment_settings entity exists; module unbuilt.

testPlan.desc: e2e: editing the permission matrix immediately changes CapabilitiesGuard decisions

regressionRisk.desc: editing role_permissions live can lock out capabilities for all roles including Owner; needs a floor/guard

tasks.title: Discord bot foundation (discord.js + new migration)
tasks.summary: Add discord.js; DiscordModule hosting an in-process gateway Client (login on init, graceful destroy) with a DiscordGateway provider (assign/remove role, list roles, send DM/message, fetch member). Onboarding: /discord/bind, /discord/verify-connection, /discord/bot-status. NEW migration for discord_bot_settings + discord_sync_jobs (outbox); the real bot now writes discord_connections + bot_operations. New env: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN, DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID.

questions.q: Confirm production bot will have the GUILD_MEMBERS privileged intent enabled and sit above every role it manages.

testPlan.desc: bot connects to a test guild; status + heartbeat persist; wizard connection check passes

regressionRisk.desc: in-process bot shares the web process lifecycle; login/reconnect/shutdown must not crash the API

history.note: created during bf-init; Phase 07 — new schema + net-new bot runtime

tasks.title: Bot core sync engine + control API
tasks.summary: Outbox worker draining discord_sync_jobs in batches (~25/min) with retry, recording to bot_operations + audit_log_entries.discord_sync_status. Enqueue on rank/role/medal change and Discord-role relink. Application-decision DMs, event reminders (from event_notify_offsets), announcement broadcast. Bot-control API: /discord/connection, /resync, /reinvite, /operations/:id/resolve, /settings, /announce.

testPlan.desc: e2e (gateway mocked): rank change enqueues -> drains -> audits with sync status; failures surface as resolvable bot_operations

tasks.title: Bot onboarding automation + slash commands
tasks.summary: On GuildMemberAdd: send welcome (DM/channel per settings) + auto-assign join_role_id; optional reaction-roles. Guild-scoped slash commands registered on boot: /roster, /event, /apply, /whoami — resolve against the same services, ephemeral responses.

questions.q: Confirm slash set (/roster /event /apply /whoami), guild-scoped vs global, ephemeral responses; and whether reaction-roles are in scope for v1.

testPlan.desc: join a test guild -> welcome + join role fire; each slash command returns correct data

tasks.title: Hardening, cross-stack E2E & production deploy
tasks.summary: Full cross-stack E2E (dashboard action -> API -> bot -> Discord), the /security-review skill (helmet, CORS allowlist, rate limits, secret handling, token/password encryption, privileged-intent scoping), production Docker build + deploy (MySQL, TLS/domain, secrets, Discord production app), seed/demo data, smoke test and a launch checklist. Depends cross-repo on the frontend integration (see the lords-regiment-dashboard refs below).

testPlan.desc: post-deploy smoke: real Discord sign-in works and one role sync is visible in the live guild
